preconditions.description: N must be an integer between 1 and 4 inclusive.
K must be an integer greater than 1 and less than 10.
The total number of possible strings of length N must be between 1 and 4096.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string must be equal to K^N + N - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(any(stdout[i:i+N] == ''.join(str(j) for j in range(K)) for i in range(len(stdout) - N + 1)) for j in range(K))
postconditions.description: The output string must contain all possible strings of length N as substrings.
